run_gen_build_yaml: run the gen_build_yaml script to generate build.json data for all naming tests
build_resolver_test_cases: build resolver test cases from YAML resolver component data into structured test case dicts
build_expected_addrs_cmd_arg: build a semicolon-separated command-line argument string from a list of expected address dicts
append_zone_name: append a DNS zone name to a record name to produce a fully qualified target name
review_main: review the main function that reads resolver_test_record_groups.yaml and outputs YAML test case data
